**#1 — Attribution cut off:** [PR #38](https://github.com/bertrandvidal/sound-map/pull/38), already merged. Root cause wasn't the LogoutButton overlap I first guessed — it was a missing global CSS reset: no `margin: 0` on `body`, so the default 8px browser margin plus the `100vh` map made the page a few px taller than the viewport, adding a scrollbar that pushed the attribution control below the fold. Fixed with a small `src/index.css` reset.

**#2 — Faster now-playing updates:** [PR #39](https://github.com/bertrandvidal/sound-map/pull/39), branch `faster-now-playing-updates`, not yet merged.
- Poll interval 5s → 3s.
- Skip now peeks Spotify's queue in parallel with the skip request and shows the predicted next track immediately, instead of waiting on a resync that can briefly return stale (pre-skip) data.
- Added a location-loading spinner in the now-playing card — it turns out the location text was silently showing the *previous* artist's place while the new one resolved, which the spinner now fixes rather than just masking a UI delay.
